title: To redesignate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 161 Live Oak Street in Miami, Arizona, as the "Staff Sergeant Manuel V. Mendoza Post Office Building".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 161 Live Oak Street in Miami, Arizona, as the "Staff Sergeant Manuel V. Mendoza Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Renames a Postal Service building in Miami, Arizona, after Staff Sergeant Manuel V. Mendoza.
summary.what_it_does: This law names the Postal Service facility at 161 Live Oak Street in Miami, Arizona, the Staff Sergeant Manuel V. Mendoza Post Office Building. It changes only the official name of the building. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
